# StockUnboxed

> Institutional financial intelligence, 10-year forensic balance sheet audits, and primary filing decoders verified against SEBI, BSE, NSE, and US SEC EDGAR disclosures. Zero stock tips, zero noise.

StockUnboxed is an independent financial research platform analyzing corporate capital allocation, cash flow conversion quality, and governance health directly from official statutory disclosures.

## Core Desks & Financial Tools
- [Corporate Forensic Analysis Hub](https://stockunboxed.github.io/): Global financial intelligence hub, statutory audit directory, and forensic case studies.
- [Indian Corporate Forensics](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/): Indian equity filings, 10-year balance sheet audits, and ROCE analyses.
- [US Corporate Forensics & SEC EDGAR Hub](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/): SEC 10-K teardowns, GAAP vs Non-GAAP reconciliations, and cash flow conversions.
- [SEBI DRHP IPO Risk Directory](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/ipo-drhp-audits): Indian IPO draft red herring prospectus reviews, debt encumbrances, and OFS proceed allocations.
- [US GAAP vs Non-GAAP Reconciliation Desk](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/gaap-reconciliations): Deconstruction of stock-based compensation (SBC), ASC 985-20 software capitalization, and cash flow conversion.
- [Statutory Brokerage Calculator](https://stockunboxed.github.io/tools/brokerage-calculator): Institutional transaction drag, STT, exchange turnover fees, and SEBI charges model.
- [SIP & Inflation Compounding Calculator](https://stockunboxed.github.io/tools/sip-calculator): Real purchasing power, CPI inflation drag, and systematic investment models.

## Indian Forensic Case Studies (SEBI & BSE/NSE Verified)
- [Tata Motors Demerger & JLR De-leveraging: From £2.3B Debt to 72.3% Automotive ROCE Audit](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/tata-motors-demerger-jlr-debt-roce-case-study): Tata Motors completed its corporate demerger on Nov 12, 2025 into two focused listed entities: TML Commercial Vehicles (FY26 revenue ₹83,855 Cr, +9.8% YoY, EBITDA margin 12.3%, ROCE 72.3%, Net Cash ₹13,713 Cr) and TMPVL Passenger Vehicles & JLR (FY26 continuing revenue ₹3,35,582 Cr, wholesales 949,501 units, R&D spend ₹34,562 Cr).
- [Hyundai Motor India IPO Audit: 3.5% Royalty Outflow to Korea vs Talegaon EV Factory CapEx](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/hyundai-motor-india-royalty-outflow-vs-ev-capex): Hyundai Motor India IPO forensic audit. Examining 3.5% royalty cash outflows to parent Hyundai Korea versus ₹6,000 Cr Talegaon factory CapEx.
- [Force Motors Ltd: Shared Mobility Urbania Ramp-Up & Luxury Engine Assembly Margin Inflection](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/force-motors-van-chassis-ebitda-inflection): Force Motors achieved an EBITDA margin inflection from 8.2% to 14.7% driven by high-margin Urbania shared mobility vans and Mercedes/BMW engine assembly.
- [SBI Mutual Fund (SBI Funds Management) IPO Forensics: ₹11 Lakh Cr AUM & 58% Operating ROCE](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/sbi-funds-management-ipo-amc-roce-analysis): Pre-IPO balance sheet forensics for SBI Funds Management. India's largest AMC with ₹11.24 Lakh Cr AUM, 64.2% operating margin, and zero debt.
- [Hero FinCorp IPO Audit: Retail Two-Wheeler Portfolio vs Unsecured Personal Loan Asset Quality](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/hero-fincorp-retail-unsecured-lending-drhp): Hero FinCorp SEBI DRHP balance sheet audit. ₹54,200 Cr AUM, 4.12% GNPA in personal loans, and captive dealer distribution moats.
- [PhonePe Ltd Pre-IPO Forensics: 48% UPI Market Share, Payment Gateway Margins & Indus Appstore CapEx](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/phonepe-indus-appstore-upi-monetization-forensics): PhonePe pre-IPO balance sheet forensics. 48% UPI volume share, $1.55T annualized TPV, ₹6,120 Cr revenue, and Indus Appstore Android monetization.
- [Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL): ₹76,000 Cr Defence Order Book & Working Capital Execution Forensics](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/bharat-electronics-bel-defence-order-book-execution): Forensic balance sheet audit of Bharat Electronics. Examining its ₹76,240 Cr defense order backlog, negative 18-day working capital cycle, and zero debt.
- [Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders: Percentage-of-Completion Revenue Forensics & Project 75I Pipeline](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/mazagon-dock-defence-shipbuilding-milestone-accounting): Mazagon Dock balance sheet forensics. Deconstructing percentage-of-completion accounting across ₹39,872 Cr submarine backlog and ₹14,650 Cr cash float.
- [Sterlite Technologies (STL): Balance Sheet De-leveraging, QIP Proceeds & Optical Interconnect Audit](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/sterlite-technologies-optical-fiber-debt-reconstruction): Sterlite Tech balance sheet audit. Tracing net debt reduction from ₹3,420 Cr to ₹1,850 Cr following ₹1,000 Cr QIP and optical interconnect recovery.
- [Varun Beverages (VBL): PepsiCo Africa Franchise Acquisition & Indian Volume Seasonality De-risking](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/varun-beverages-vbl-pepsico-africa-expansion): Varun Beverages balance sheet audit. PepsiCo Africa BevCo acquisition, 1.12 billion cases volume, 23.0% EBITDA margin, and seasonality smoothing.
- [Zepto (Athera Technologies) IPO DRHP Deconstruction: 950 Dark Stores & Path to Contribution Margin Breakeven](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/zepto-quick-commerce-ipo-dark-store-economics): Zepto SEBI DRHP balance sheet deconstruction. Annualized GMV of ₹16,500 Cr, AOV ₹512, 21.4% take rate, and 950 dark store expansion.
- [Sun Pharma Halol & Mohali USFDA Warning Letter Remediation & Specialty Portfolio Pivot](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/sun-pharma-tildrakizumab-usfda-warning-letter-audit): Sun Pharma balance sheet forensics. Deconstructing the remediation of USFDA Form 483 warning letters and global specialty revenue scaling to $1.2B.
- [Divi's Laboratories: ₹1,500 Cr Kakinada CDMO CapEx & 40% Operating Margin Defense](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/divis-laboratories-custom-synthesis-cdmo-capex): Divi's Labs balance sheet audit. ₹1,500 Cr Kakinada API facility commissioning, 40.2% EBITDA margin, and global Big Pharma custom synthesis contracts.
- [Trent Ltd (Zudio & Westside): 1,000-Store Milestone, Q2 FY27 Margins & Ind AS 116 Lease Forensics](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/trent-ltd-zudio-1000-stores-q2-fy27-revenue-margin-audit): Trent Ltd Q2 FY27 standalone revenue rose 23% YoY to ₹5,788 Cr (vs ₹4,724 Cr in Q2 FY26) with H1 FY27 standalone revenue at ₹11,454 Cr (+21% YoY). Zudio crossed the 1,000-store milestone adding 17 net new stores in Q2 across 300+ cities, bringing total retail store network to 1,342 stores as of Sep 30, 2026.
- [Jubilant FoodWorks vs Devyani International: QSR SSSG, Delivery Economics & Ind AS 116 Lease Ledger Audit](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/jubilant-foodworks-vs-devyani-international-qsr-sssg-lease-audit): Forensic comparison of Jubilant FoodWorks (Domino's India, Market Cap ₹32,722 Cr, ROE 18.69%, P/E 72.71x, D/E 2.14x) against Devyani International (KFC & Pizza Hut, Market Cap ₹17,613 Cr, 2,256 stores, EBITDA margin 15.2%, D/E 2.49x). Analyzes aggregator commission drag vs captive 20-minute delivery fleet economics.
- [Lupin Ltd Q2 FY27 USFDA & ANDA Portfolio Audit: 74.2% Gross Margin, Net Cash & 48 First-to-Files](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/lupin-q2-fy27-usfda-anda-pipeline-gross-margin-audit): Lupin Ltd Q2 FY27 financial and USFDA filing audit: Gross profit rose 15.4% YoY to ₹5,777.4 Cr with 74.2% gross margin. US sales rose 9.3% YoY to ₹3,020.2 Cr ($317M). Operating cash flows expanded net cash to ₹3,349 Cr (Net Debt/Equity -0.14) with cumulative USFDA filings reaching 429 ANDAs (353 approved, 48 FTFs).
- [Sun Pharma vs Dr. Reddy's & Aurobindo: USFDA Form 483, OAI Regulatory Classification & Specialty Moats](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/dr-reddys-sun-pharma-aurobindo-usfda-form-483-oai-audit): Comparative regulatory and forensic audit of India's top pharma exporters: Sun Pharma ($1,420M Innovative Medicines sales, 30.3% EBITDA margin, ₹11,479 Cr PAT) vs Dr. Reddy's (FTO-11 mild 2-observation Form 483, Takeda & Gilead licensing) vs Aurobindo Pharma (Lannett USFDA Official Action Indicated status).
- [Bajaj Finance Q2 FY27 Financial Autopsy: ₹5,84,624 Cr AUM, 1.06% GNPA & ₹17,500 Cr Capital Infusion](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/bajaj-finance-q2-fy27-aum-npa-qip-warrants-audit): Bajaj Finance Q2 FY27 primary filing audit: Consolidated PAT rose 29% YoY to ₹6,367 Cr (₹6,619 Cr pre-overlay, +34% YoY). AUM grew 26.5% YoY to ₹5,84,624 Cr (+₹37,680 Cr in Q2). GNPA improved to 1.06%, Net NPA fell to 0.42%, with ROE at 20.6% and CRAR robust at 20.33% following a ₹17,500 Cr capital raise.
- [HDFC Bank Post-Merger Balance Sheet Audit: LDR Normalization, 3.26% NIM Compression & ₹45.78L Cr Footprint](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/hdfc-bank-post-merger-ldr-nim-balance-sheet-audit): HDFC Bank post-merger balance sheet audit across Q1 and Q2 FY27: Standalone PAT reached ₹19,510 Cr (+4.7% YoY; +12.6% ex-treasury) with consolidated balance sheet crossing ₹45.78 Lakh Crore. Advances grew 15.4% YoY to ₹30.61 Lakh Cr while deposits grew 14.7% to ₹31.71 Lakh Cr. NIM compressed to 3.26% (110 bps below ICICI Bank), with Net NPA at 0.37% and Tier-1 CAR at 17.2%.
- [Bajaj Auto Q2 FY27 Financial Autopsy: ₹20,003 Cr Revenue, 20.85% EBITDA Margin & Chetak EV Scaling](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/bajaj-auto-q2-fy27-exports-ev-margin-audit): Bajaj Auto Q2 FY27 financial audit: Standalone revenue rose 34.1% YoY to ₹20,003.4 Cr (consolidated revenue ₹25,125.6 Cr, +59.7% YoY). Standalone EBITDA expanded 36.7% YoY to ₹4,170.8 Cr with a 20.85% EBITDA margin (+40 bps). Total volume reached 15,48,884 units (+20% YoY) powered by a 41% surge in exports (7,78,528 units) and Chetak EV market share expansion.
- [Eternal (Blinkit) vs Zepto & Swiggy: Quick Commerce Dark Store Unit Economics & DRHP Forensic Audit](https://stockunboxed.github.io/in/case-studies/zomato-eternal-blinkit-zepto-drhp-dark-store-unit-economics-audit): Forensic audit of India's quick-commerce wars: Eternal Ltd (formerly Zomato) Q2 FY27 Blinkit operations reached 2,751 dark stores (+308 in Q2), 398.9M orders, ₹20,940 Cr Net Order Value (NOV), and positive Adjusted EBITDA of +₹184 Cr (0.9% of NOV). Reconciles against Swiggy Instamart (1,240 stores, -₹895 Cr EBITDA loss) and Zepto's June 2026 Updated Draft IPO Prospectus (1,139 stores, -₹5,042 Cr FY26 Adjusted EBITDA loss or ~₹79 loss per order, ₹5,905 Cr net loss).

## US Forensic Case Studies (SEC EDGAR Verified)
- [Apple 10-Year Capital Return Teardown: How Services Expansion & $600B in Buybacks Transformed ROE to 150%](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/apple-services-margin-teardown): Apple re-architected its financial engine over the past decade by building a $100B annualized Services segment with 74% gross margins, while repurchasing over $600 billion of common stock to contract share count by 38% and elevate ROE beyond 150%.
- [Nvidia Corporation FY26 Forensics: $215.9B Revenue, Blackwell GB200 Ramps & 75% Gross Margin Defense](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/nvidia-fy26-blackwell-gross-margin-cash-flow): Nvidia Corporation FY26 10-K audit. $215.9B revenue (+65.4%), Blackwell GB200 data center ramps, 74.8% gross margin, and $98.5B free cash flow.
- [D-Wave Quantum vs IonQ: Commercial Annealing Revenue, Cash Burn Rates & Dilution Forensics](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/dwave-quantum-annealing-cash-burn-runway): D-Wave Quantum balance sheet forensics. $12.4M commercial revenue, $64.2M operating cash burn, and ATM equity dilution analysis vs IonQ.
- [Applied Materials (AMAT): Gate-All-Around (GAA) Transistor Transition & China WFE Export Control Exposure](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/applied-materials-wafer-fab-equipment-china-wfe): Applied Materials 10-K audit. $28.4B revenue, Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistor tooling inflections, and de-risking China WFE revenue exposure.
- [Fox Corporation & Tubi AVOD Forensics: 82 Million Active Viewers & Free Ad-Supported Streaming Cash Flows](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/fox-corporation-tubi-streaming-ebitda-turnaround): Fox Corporation 10-K forensics. Tubi advertising revenue exceeded $1.15B (+26%), capturing 82M MAUs and 2.1% of total US television viewing.
- [Walmart vs The Home Depot: Supply Chain Inventory Velocity, Payables Leverage & ROIC Divergence](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/walmart-vs-home-depot-inventory-turnover-divergence): Working capital forensics comparing Walmart and Home Depot. Walmart's 8.4x inventory turns and payables leverage vs Home Depot's 34.8% ROIC.
- [Tesla Energy Storage Forensics: 31.4 GWh Megapack Deployments & 30.5% Gross Margin Inflection](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/tesla-megapack-energy-storage-margin-inflection): Tesla Energy Storage 10-K audit. 31.4 GWh Megapack deployments (+105% YoY), $10.15B revenue, and 30.5% gross margin surpassing automotive.
- [NOV Inc (National Oilwell Varco): Offshore Drilling Equipment Backlog & Working Capital Conversion Drag](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/nov-inc-oilfield-equipment-working-capital-drag): NOV Inc balance sheet forensics. $4.25B energy equipment backlog, 118-day cash conversion cycle, and working capital drag on EBITDA conversion.
- [Barrick Gold Corporation: $2,650/oz Gold Realization, All-In Sustaining Costs (AISC) & Nevada Gold Mines](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/barrick-gold-all-in-sustaining-costs-aisc): Barrick Gold Corporation Form 40-F audit. 4.02M oz gold production, $1,340/oz AISC, $1,145/oz operating margin, and Nevada Gold Mines joint venture.
- [CoreWeave AI Cloud Forensics: $12B Debt-Financed GPU Collateral & $17B Hyperscaler Contract Backlog](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/coreweave-debt-fueled-ai-cloud-backlog-forensics): Pre-IPO balance sheet forensics of CoreWeave. Examining $11.8B debt facility backed by Nvidia GPU collateral, $2.6B ARR, and $17.2B contract backlog.
- [Palantir Technologies AIP Forensics: US Commercial Revenue Surge (+54% YoY), Rule of 68 & FCF Conversion](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/palantir-aip-enterprise-net-retention-rule-of-40): Palantir Technologies Form 10-K audit. US Commercial revenue jumped 54% YoY to $702M, 36.5% adjusted free cash flow margin, and Rule of 68 score.
- [Berkshire Hathaway Capital Allocation Audit: $377B Cash Hoard, US Treasury Yields & Apple Stake Trimming](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/berkshire-hathaway-377b-cash-treasury-float): Berkshire Hathaway capital allocation audit. Deconstructing the $377B cash and Treasury bill hoard, $174B insurance float, and Apple share liquidation.
- [Axon Enterprise vs Motorola Solutions: Software ARR Growth (41%), Cloud Retention & Public Safety Moats](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/axon-enterprise-taser-cloud-software-moat): Axon Enterprise balance sheet audit. Cloud ARR expanded 41% YoY to $885M with 122% Net Revenue Retention, challenging Motorola Solutions.
- [HIVE Digital Technologies: Bitcoin Mining Fleet to Tier-3 HPC GPU Data Center Power Conversion](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/hive-digital-hpc-data-center-gpu-pivot): HIVE Digital Technologies Form 20-F audit. Converting stranded crypto power capacity into Tier-3 HPC GPU data centers yielding $34.2M in high-margin cloud revenue.
- [Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) Q3 2026 10-Q Audit: Comps, Operating Leases & Restaurant-Level Margin Compression](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/chipotle-cmg-q3-2026-comp-sales-margin-lease-audit): Chipotle Mexican Grill Q3 2026 10-Q filing audit: Total revenue rose 9.6% YoY to $3.30B ($3,300M) driven by 2.1% comparable restaurant sales and 84 new restaurant openings (53 Chipotlanes). Restaurant-level operating margin compressed 120 bps to 23.3%, with operating cash flow reaching $1,922M for 9M 2026 against $5.28B in operating lease liabilities.
- [Eli Lilly (LLY) Q3 2026 10-Q Audit: Mounjaro & Zepbound Scaling, 83.9% Gross Margin & $92B FY26 Guidance](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/eli-lilly-lly-q3-2026-mounjaro-zepbound-gross-margin-audit): Eli Lilly Q3 2026 10-Q filing audit: Total revenue surged 39% YoY to $24.4B ($24,397M) powered by Mounjaro and Zepbound. GAAP gross margin reached 83.9% ($20.5B). Net income rose 16% YoY to $6,451M ($7.22 EPS) after absorbing $4.57/share in acquired in-process R&D charges. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to $91.0B–$92.0B.
- [JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Q3 2026 10-Q Audit: $50.9B Revenue, $27.1B NII, 20% ROTCE & $5.2T AUM Milestone](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/jpmorgan-chase-jpm-q3-2026-nii-rotce-balance-sheet-audit): JPMorgan Chase Q3 2026 10-Q filing audit: Managed net revenue rose 8% YoY to $50.9B ($50,910M) with Net Interest Income rising 13% YoY to $27.1B. GAAP net income reached $15.3B ($5.57 EPS, 20% ROTCE) or $15.8B ($5.75 EPS, 21% ROTCE) excluding securities losses. Consumer banking added >650,000 net checking accounts, while Asset & Wealth Management crossed $5.2T in AUM ($7.9T client assets).
- [Tesla (TSLA) Forensic Audit: Automotive Gross Margin Ex-Regulatory Credits vs 31.4% Megapack Energy Inflection](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/tesla-tsla-auto-margin-regulatory-credits-energy-audit): Tesla financial audit analyzing automotive margin dynamics vs utility-scale stationary energy storage: Energy storage deployments reached 46.7 GWh (+49% YoY, 168% 3-Yr CAGR) generating $12.7B in revenue (+27% YoY) and ~$3.8B in gross profit (~30% margin). In Q3 2026, Energy gross margin exceeded 31.4% while total consolidated gross profit rose 9% YoY to $5.5B.
- [CoreWeave (CRWV) Q3 2026 10-Q Audit: $46.87B Debt Load, GPU Depreciation Curves & $132.5B Backlog](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/coreweave-crwv-debt-gpu-depreciation-forensic-audit): CoreWeave Q3 2026 Form 10-Q filing audit: Revenue surged 168% YoY to $3,661M ($3.66B vs $1,365M in Q3 2025). However, GAAP operating income was limited to $207M (6% margin) due to aggressive GPU asset depreciation. Net interest expense jumped to $846M (vs $310M), driving a GAAP net loss of -$709M (-$1.27 diluted EPS). Total debt reached $46.87B backed by $56.78B in Property & Equipment across 1.7 GW active power and a $132.5B contracted backlog.
- [Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Q3 2026 Filing: $8.5B Data Center Milestone, EPYC Share & $1.1B Warrant Impact](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/amd-q3-2026-data-center-gpu-vs-epyc-margin-audit): Advanced Micro Devices Q3 2026 primary filing audit: Record revenue of $13.38B (+45% YoY) with Data Center revenue surging 97% YoY to $8.5B (>63% of total revenue) driven by Instinct MI350/MI400 GPUs and 5th Gen EPYC CPUs. GAAP operating income reached $2.83B (+123% YoY) with Non-GAAP operating income at $3.92B. GAAP net income was $2.43B ($1.46 EPS, impacted by a $1.10B customer warrant charge) vs Non-GAAP net income of $3.47B ($2.09 EPS). Q4 revenue guidance raised to ~$17.0B.
- [Palantir vs NVIDIA Q3 2026 Corporate Forensics: 158% Rule of 40 Score, Form 4 Filings & Hyperscaler Cash Flows](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/palantir-nvidia-q3-2026-rule-of-40-form-4-insider-audit): Comparative corporate forensic audit of AI software and hardware compounders: Palantir Technologies (Q3 2026 revenue $2,313.4M, +96% YoY, US Commercial +148% to $984M, GAAP Operating Income $1,085M at 47% margin, Adjusted FCF $1,216M at 53% margin, 158% Rule of 40 score, $10.4B cash) compared against NVIDIA (FY26 revenue $215.9B, +65% YoY, Data Center $193.7B, GAAP Net Income $120.07B, $62.56B cash).
- [Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) Q3 FY26 10-Q Audit: GTA 6 Bookings Amortization, Software Capitalization & Launch Margins](https://stockunboxed.github.io/us/case-studies/take-two-ttwo-gta-6-bookings-amortization-audit): Forensic breakdown of Take-Two (TTWO) Q2 FY27 10-Q and GTA 6 launch economics: $3.35B–$3.5B Q3 Net Bookings, GAAP revenue deferral, and GTA Online margins.
